name: Kohakuiro no Hunter
source:
Long ago, on a rusty, reddish planet floating in space, deep within its uncharted jungles, lay the Novastone Ore—a mineral said to hold immense energy.
Dreaming of striking it rich, people rushed to the planet, scrambling to claim the veins of ore for themselves.
But in this remote, untamed frontier—a place some called a "demonic realm"—what awaited them was something far beyond human comprehension.
Monsters.
Beings that defied reason.
——————Pure calamity.

[Translated from [url=https://nexton-net.jp/ms-toybox/skyrocket/kohaku/story.html]the official website[/url]]
translation:
很久以前，一颗锈红色的星球漂浮于宇宙之中。在它人迹罕至的密林深处，埋藏着据说蕴含巨大能量的“新星石”矿石。
怀抱一夜暴富梦想的人们，争先恐后地涌上星球，抢占矿脉。
然而，在这片偏远而未被驯服、甚至被称为“魔境”的开拓地，等待他们的，是远远超出人类理解的存在。
怪物。
违背常理的存在。
——灾厄本身。

[译自[url=https://nexton-net.jp/ms-toybox/skyrocket/kohaku/story.html]官方网站[/url]]
